store.title: Fantomah — Issue #0
store.description: The first AltWorld Comics release. Fantomah returns as a dark pulp jungle horror icon, reimagined with a modern visual style while preserving the strange, mythic spirit of Golden Age comics.

store.title: Dark Tales: Little Red Riding Hood
store.description: A twisted new interpretation of Little Red Riding Hood. "Dark Tales" transforms the classic fairy tale into a gothic horror fantasy filled with monsters, blood rituals and ancient woods.

about.heading: About AltWorld Comics
about.body: AltWorld Comics is a small independent comic label focused on dark pulp, retro horror, reimagined classics and original tales. We bring forgotten worlds back with a modern visual language while building new stories under the same vintage spirit.
